name: CodeX BVWP
author: Humna Sohaib

sections.description:
BazaarVoice Integration for WordPress is a powerful plugin developed by CODEXIDEA that seamlessly connects your WordPress website with the BazaarVoice platform.
It allows you to display real customer feedback, product reviews, and star ratings directly on your pages — enhancing trust, improving engagement, and increasing conversions.

💡 Why Choose BazaarVoice Integration?

Customers rely heavily on authentic reviews when making purchasing decisions.
This plugin makes it effortless to pull user-generated content (UGC) from BazaarVoice and showcase it anywhere on your site.

🚀 Key Features

  • Easy Integration – Connect your BazaarVoice account with WordPress in just a few clicks.
  • No Coding Required – Simple setup with a user-friendly interface.
  • Custom Display Options – Control where and how reviews appear (listings, detail pages, etc.).
  • Real-Time Updates – Automatically sync and show the latest customer feedback.
  • Boost Credibility – Display genuine user reviews and ratings to build trust.
  • Media Support – Allow customers to attach images, PDFs, or other media with their feedback.
  • Feedback Form Integration – Display detailed review summaries and customer feedback forms.
  • Lightweight & Fast – Optimized for performance and SEO-friendly.

⭐ Premium Features

⚠️ Premium features require a valid paid license and are not included in the free version.
– Product Catalog Generation – Create a complete product catalog with a single click.
– Automatic Upload to Bazaarvoice – Connect securely to your Bazaarvoice server and automatically push your product catalog.
– Catalog Download – Download your product catalog (XML/CSV) directly to your computer.
– Multiple Product Type Support – Fully supports both Simple and Variable WooCommerce products.

🛒 Perfect For

  • E-commerce stores looking to improve product credibility.
  • Businesses aiming to enhance user trust and transparency.
  • Brands wanting to display verified customer feedback directly from BazaarVoice.

sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin ZIP file.
  2. Upload it to your WordPress website via Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.
  3. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  4. Navigate to **Settings → CodeXidea UGC & BazaarVoice
  5. Enter your BazaarVoice API credentials and choose where you want reviews to appear.
  6. Save settings and start displaying reviews instantly.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require a BazaarVoice account?

Yes. You need an active BazaarVoice account with API access to fetch reviews and ratings.

Can I customize the display layout?

Absolutely. You can customize how reviews and ratings appear to match your website’s design.

Is it compatible with all WordPress themes?

Yes. The plugin is designed to work seamlessly with most modern WordPress themes.

Does it affect website speed?

No. It’s built lightweight, optimized for speed, and follows WordPress coding standards.

Can I show reviews on multiple pages or products?

Yes, you can display user-generated content on listing pages, detail pages, or any custom page using shortcodes or hooks.
